title: WorldWriters
description: The reviewed world writers of decision-time search (ADR-026 Evidence 1, B2 and N5): every state item a scenario world can hold is classified exactly once (E set by an engine method, W set by a reviewed writer, X resampled by the engine's own draw and counted, T reset at turn start, R refused), and the ids admitted for the generic classes are listed (a volatile, a start trigger). Reviewed data in config/search/, never code; an id is admitted only after the fidelity oracle (slice F) shows it faithful, so every id not listed is R. Integers only. Its RFC 8785 SHA-256 is world_writers_hash, a part of the search identity. A change of any value is a new record, never an edit.

format_id.description: The target format the engine ids are checked against.

items.description: One row per state item, ascending by id (reader rule: every item exactly once).

admitted.description: The admitted ids, ascending by kind then id (reader rule: sorted and unique, each in the engine's data).

StateClass.description: E engine method, W reviewed writer, X resampled by the engine's own draw, T reset at turn start, R refusal.

id.description: A state item of the closed list.

condition.description: The engine condition a writer adds (protect_counter, choice_lock, confusion_duration).

ids.description: The engine ids (or, for unavailable_mechanics, the protocol line kinds) whose presence is the item; ascending and unique.
